stim_id.Description: Stimulus identifier; the value used to join events (see README, section Stimuli).

condition.Description: Experimental condition (visual-only or audiovisual VR tour); runs 2 and 3, order per participant in metadata.xlsx (columns Run1-Run3).

source_title.Description: Title of the source work or upload.

source_id.Description: Identifier of the source (YouTube id, archive or deposit identifier, clip name).

source_url.Description: Where the source can be obtained (official page, upload or deposit). Not a copy made by us.

rights.Description: Rights note. 'third-party; not included': the video belongs to its rights holder and is not part of this dataset.

source_duration_s.Description: Duration of the source upload or file named in source_id.

fps.Description: Frame rate of the current YouTube upload (ffprobe).

width.Description: Frame width of the current YouTube upload.

height.Description: Frame height of the current YouTube upload.

verification.Description: How identity and timing were checked.

Levels.likely: identity from the dataset README; onset inside the run not verifiable
